# sarahdigs

> sarahdigs is a creative website studio that designs and builds high-performing, brand-led websites optimized for Google, AI search (AEO/GEO), and real user experience. Founded by Sarah Islam.

sarahdigs helps businesses get found on Google and AI search engines while delivering websites real users love. The studio's work spans brand strategy, UX design, custom development, SEO, and answer-engine optimization (AEO/GEO).

## Services

- [The Full Dig](https://www.sarahdigs.com/the-full-dig): End-to-end engagement — brand-led website design, build, and launch for businesses ready to be remembered.
- [Dig on Demand](https://www.sarahdigs.com/dig-on-demand): Ongoing design and development support for businesses with a live site that needs to keep moving.
- [Dig-in Consultations](https://www.sarahdigs.com/dig-in-consultations): A focused call and written action plan for clarity before committing to a full engagement.

## Work

- [Selected Work](https://www.sarahdigs.com/projects): Case studies from the studio — brand-led websites built for businesses that want to be remembered.

## Journal

- [The Journal](https://www.sarahdigs.com/journal): Essays and field notes on web design, AI search visibility (AEO/GEO), and building a brand that gets found.
